chapters.title: Solomon made king
chapters.summary: As David grows old, his son Adonijah declares himself king. Nathan and Bathsheba remind David of his promise, and Solomon is anointed king.

chapters.title: David's charge to Solomon
chapters.summary: David tells Solomon to walk in God's ways and then dies. Solomon secures his throne by dealing with Adonijah, Joab and Shimei.

chapters.title: Solomon asks for wisdom
chapters.summary: God offers Solomon anything he asks. He asks for an understanding heart to judge God's people, and God gives him wisdom, riches and honor. He wisely settles two mothers' dispute over a baby.

chapters.title: Solomon's officials and wisdom
chapters.summary: Solomon organizes his kingdom. Judah and Israel live in peace and plenty, and his wisdom, proverbs and songs become famous.

chapters.title: Preparing to build
chapters.summary: Solomon makes an agreement with Hiram of Tyre for cedar and craftsmen, and conscripts labor to build the temple his father could not build.

chapters.title: Building the temple
chapters.summary: In the fourth year of his reign, Solomon begins the temple. Its stone, cedar, gold and cherubim are described, and God promises to dwell among Israel.

chapters.title: Palace and furnishings
chapters.summary: Solomon builds his palace over thirteen years. Huram the bronze worker makes the pillars, the great bronze sea and the temple furnishings.

chapters.title: The temple dedicated
chapters.summary: The ark is brought in and the glory cloud fills the temple. Solomon prays that God will hear prayers made toward this house, though heaven cannot contain Him.

chapters.title: God answers Solomon
chapters.summary: God appears to Solomon again, promising to keep his throne if he is faithful and warning of ruin if Israel turns away.

chapters.title: The queen of Sheba
chapters.summary: The queen of Sheba visits to test Solomon with hard questions and is amazed: the half was not told me. Solomon's wealth is beyond measure.

chapters.title: Solomon turns away
chapters.summary: Solomon's many foreign wives turn his heart to other gods. God raises up enemies and promises to tear the kingdom from his son, leaving one tribe for David's sake.

chapters.title: The kingdom divides
chapters.summary: Rehoboam rejects the elders' advice and threatens harsher labor. The northern tribes make Jeroboam king, and he sets up golden calves at Bethel and Dan.

chapters.title: The man of God from Judah
chapters.summary: A prophet denounces Jeroboam's altar at Bethel. On his way home he is deceived into disobeying God's word and is killed by a lion.

chapters.title: Judgment on Jeroboam
chapters.summary: The prophet Ahijah foretells disaster for Jeroboam's family. In Judah, Rehoboam's people also do evil, and Egypt plunders the temple.

chapters.title: Abijam, Asa and northern kings
chapters.summary: Abijam reigns briefly in Judah, then Asa does right and removes idols. In Israel, Baasha kills Nadab and takes the throne.

chapters.title: Ahab comes to power
chapters.summary: Israel's throne passes through violence to Omri, who builds Samaria. His son Ahab marries Jezebel and serves Baal more than any king before him.

chapters.title: Elijah and the widow
chapters.summary: Elijah announces a drought. Ravens feed him by a brook, and a widow of Zarephath shares her last meal; her flour and oil do not run out, and Elijah raises her son.

chapters.title: Fire on Mount Carmel
chapters.summary: Elijah challenges Baal's prophets: the God who answers by fire is God. Baal is silent, the Lord sends fire on Elijah's soaked altar, and rain ends the drought.

chapters.title: The still small voice
chapters.summary: Fleeing Jezebel, Elijah wants to die. An angel feeds him, and at Horeb God speaks not in wind, earthquake or fire but in a still small voice. Elisha is called.

chapters.title: Ahab and the Arameans
chapters.summary: God gives Ahab victories over Ben-hadad of Aram to show He is Lord of hills and valleys, but Ahab spares the enemy king and is rebuked.

chapters.title: Naboth's vineyard
chapters.summary: Jezebel arranges the murder of Naboth so Ahab can take his vineyard. Elijah pronounces judgment, and Ahab humbles himself.

chapters.title: Micaiah's prophecy
chapters.summary: Ahab's court prophets promise victory, but Micaiah foretells his death. Ahab is killed in battle by a random arrow. Jehoshaphat reigns well in Judah.
